fichas.title: Butcher: example ground plan for 6–7 employees
fichas.summary: A butcher’s workshop for in-house sausage and cold-meat production. Meat moves from the sausage machine room through smoking and boiling processes to cold storage or the shop. The page specifies workroom and passage dimensions, machine clearances, finishes, services, lighting, and staff facilities.
